The multiple arbitrage
Buy good businesses at 3–5× profit.

Then
Combine them into one group, and build more value.

Buyers pay more for the group.
One business on its own3–5× EBITDA
A consolidated group, to private equity8–15× EBITDA
That's the doubling and tripling of your money.
